anchor_verification.detail: Anchor root hash matches. Trace is at checkpoint state.

caveats: This report aggregates existing evidence. It does not constitute a formal security review.
Trace verification checks chain continuity, ordering, and hash correctness under Blake3HashPolicy. It does not prove physical immutability.
An attacker who can rewrite the trace store AND recompute all hashes can produce a self-consistent trace. Full immutability requires an external trust anchor.
Not production-ready. Not a stable API guarantee.
